name: qlcplus
description: Q Light Controller Plus (QLC+) is a free and cross-platform software to control DMX or analog lighting systems like moving heads, dimmers, scanners etc. This project is a fork of the great QLC project written by Heikki Junnila that aims to continue the QLC development and to introduce new features.
summary: Q 光控制器 Plus (QLC+) 是一款免费且跨平台的软件，用于控制 DMX 或模拟照明系统，如移动头、调光器、扫描器等。该项目是 Heikki Junnila 所著的 QLC 项目的分支，旨在继续 QLC 的开发并引入新功能
